640-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

512-5475-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5475-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5475-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-1339-1940.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-1940.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-3249-5687--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-5687--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3318-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Fabled Passage.
3318-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Fabled Passage.
When Fabled Passage enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Fabled Passage by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

1981-2415-5708-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Fatestitcher or Clever Conjurer

950-2872-7786.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-7061.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Solid Ground
Repeat.

1183-1563-2433-4321.description:
Activate Pentavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token and a Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Rosie Cotton triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus and another +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6768-7692.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-5078-6768-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3330-3490-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1445-2292-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

775-851-1409.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

104-3490-5231-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-6719.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4593-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2034-3000-4593-6458.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4593-6458.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2034-4593-5070-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-5070-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2452-3249-5670-6794--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-6794--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

2099-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
2099-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

67-2781-5686.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

380-997-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities.

252-5256-5394.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2523-2921-5561.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

397-640-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-640-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

413-2608-5168-5542.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a black or red permanent
413-2608-5168-5542.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
413-2608-5168-5542.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Blasting Station triggers once.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the first Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.

4365-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
4365-4518-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1235-3368-4863-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Twinflame.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of Twinflame, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reiterate to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Repeat steps 3 through 10.
After the second iteration, you may instead target Revolutionist and any other creature you control using the Twinflame copies.

233-575-714-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
233-575-714-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Swamp creature due to Kormus Bell and Urborg.
Repeat.

851-1409-2208.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
851-1409-2208.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1275-1517-2103.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
1275-1517-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chisei triggers, removing a lore counter from The Mirari Conjecture.
After your draw step, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2493-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2427-2493-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
